newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades Oregon Steel Mills notes.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades Oregon Steel Mills notes.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co Thursday downgraded its rating on the first mortgage notes of Oregon Steel Mills Inc to double-B from double-B-plus.
About $235 million in securities is affected.
Duff & Phelps said the move is in anticipation of worse-than-expected results in 1997 and the related reduction in liquidity as the company prepares to launch a rolling mill.
Oregon Steel has pushed back the mill's startup by three months because of a dispute with a contractor. The delay has cost the company about $20 million, Duff & Phelps said.
Oregon Steel makes steel and wire products.
The company's stock was unchanged Thursday afternoon at 17.
